name: Option Barrier Level 1 Choice
definition: Choice of barrier levels for an option.

Single.name: Single
Single.definition: For a barrier option involving only one barrier level, specifies the predetermined price of an underlier at which the occurrence of a barrier event (e.g. knock-out) is determined.

Multiple.name: Multiple
Multiple.definition: For a barrier option involving two barrier levels, specifies the lower and upper levels as a predetermined price of an underlier at which the occurrence of a barrier event (such as a knock-out) is determined.
